newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Gaddum - no way to help capital mkt rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Gaddum - no way to help capital mkt rates fall.

text.p: Bundesbank vice president Johann Wilhelm Gaddum said on Friday that he did not see any chance or need for the Bundesbank to act to accelerate the decline at the long end of capital market interest rates.
Speaking in a German television interview, Gaddum also said that interest rates were low and a cut in interest rates at present would not achieve much.
Gaddum said the Bundesbank's monetary policy had succeeded in creating a situation in which long-term interest rates were generally stable or trending downward.
"I see no need or any possibility for monetary policy to accelerate this process," Gaddum said.
